Gumla men dharmantran aur aadivasi asmita ko lekar ek naya vivad khara ho gaya hai... raydih prakhand ke kobja ganv men gram sabha ne aisa phaisla liya hai… jisne kaee bare saval khare kar die hain... ganv men eesaee dharm ke pastar aur padriyon ke pravesh par rok lagane ka nirnay liya gaya hai... itna hi nahin, bakayda ganv men pratibandh ka bord bhi laga diya gaya hai...
